Test Case '-[FluidDictationIntegrationTests.MeetingHistorySnapshotTests testRapidCorrectionsCannotBeOverwrittenByAnOlderHistoryRead]' passed.

Observed before: all three catalog APIs silently accepted invalid manifests; the real history snapshot cleared its previously loaded row and showed no error.
Observed after: an all-failure catalog throws, the snapshot retains its row and reports failure, retry after repair succeeds. Empty/stale catalogs and healthy neighbors preserve existing behavior.
